decision_rule: Use the two revealed weeks only to decide whether a structural path exists. A candidate may receive a new prospectively locked random BTC week only if the central and at least one adjacent response horizon show sufficient frequency and positive after-cost expectancy in both revealed weeks. Revealed-week performance is never project certification.

hypothesis.ambiguous_state: no trade when impact decays, flow changes sign, depth refills materially or cost-after geometry is insufficient
hypothesis.entry: market order at the completed response minute
hypothesis.event_clock: first ten seconds of every quarter-hour opening minute
hypothesis.initial_shock: opening ten-second flow, turnover and return exceed prior-only event quantiles and remain aligned through the completed opening minute
hypothesis.invalidation: pre-burst close plus 0.10 prior ATR against the delivery direction
hypothesis.liquidity_condition: front-side one-percent depth may refill by at most five percent during the opening minute
hypothesis.objective: one frozen prior 60-minute accepted-close range from entry
hypothesis.permanence_confirmation: after 2, 3 or 4 completed response minutes, price retains at least 100 percent of the opening-minute impact and mean aggressive flow remains directionally non-negative

research_basis.implication: temporary impact and post-metaorder decay must be measured rather than inferred from aggressive flow alone
research_basis.reference: Bacry et al., Market impacts and the life cycle of investors' orders

research_basis.implication: retained and decayed impact are distinct states
research_basis.reference: Bucci et al., Slow decay of impact in equity markets

research_basis.implication: an intraday market-structure shift is a short-horizon delivery state and should not automatically be generalized into a multi-session trend
